checks.name: Real Rapier WASM world: gravity, two rigid bodies, one floor and one capsule
Bind-derived legs and shoe offsets initialize at floor, with fixed lengths
Idle remains grounded without horizontal drift
Walking actually translates forward and follows a radius .50 path
Long walk stays on a small circle and exercises both stance and swing
Walk-to-idle finishes the airborne step and holds both soles on floor
Authored four-second turn completes a full revolution without Euler branch reversal
Wave retains grounded position and feet
Interrupted turn settles feet without a heading snap or floating stance
Analytic IK preserves both links, rather than stretching unreachable legs
All sampled stance targets remain reachable
Sole points and actual ankle-weighted shoe vertices do not penetrate floor
Support feet do not slide relative to their locked world anchors
Walking and turning have continuous foot trajectories at 60Hz
Pause is a strict no-op
Reset returns to the original stage center and forward, on floor
Zero-substep updates do not accumulate pelvis crouching
Long frames are bounded to eight 1/120-second physics steps
30/60/120/240Hz walking produces the same path and heading
Turn no-substep path still applies finite yaw and grounded IK
Bind-derived IK supports bodyScale=0.68
Bind-derived IK supports bodyScale=0.74
Bind-derived IK supports bodyScale=1
Upright translated/yaw-rotated uniformly-scaled parent has valid world-space IK
Authored turns do not include the parent yaw as an extra first-frame rotation
Dispose frees the Rapier world and subsequent calls are no-ops

scope: Actual model + Rapier WASM, CPU numerical checks. Not visual approval or proof of whole-body dynamics.
